description: Actual original browser PNG samples over five backgrounds under two themes at three scales; effective two-point sample fits reproduce all samples within one RGB byte. Quantized two-point fits do not uniquely identify intrinsic RGBA. Resolved border bands are validated against recorded CSS RGBA and actual pixels. Cursor records are live computed DOM cursor styles.

scales.method: Actual original PNG pixels over five verified main backgrounds, under both themes; source button CSS unchanged.
scales.input: Isolated headless CDP only; no visible window or global input.
scales.two_point_fits_note: Effective first-sample fits from rounded pixels, not uniquely exact CSS alpha. At 200% the second inner band is retained separately.

edge_band_model.collapsed: 100%/150% single physical pixel, verified with its effective fit
